text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! To think that I left 
the class log behind in the classroom...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your races have looked pretty 
tough lately, after all. You can rely on 
me for things like this anytime! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I totally spaced out. Normally, 
this kind of thing never happens to me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Times like this are when I 
really need to brace myself...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road seems to have accumulated 
fatigue from her races. I should review 
her schedule.
